title: Universal Scheduler Cleanup & Consolidation — Implementation Report

summary.commit_1_docs: docs: reconcile phase5d cleanup design with shim policy
summary.commit_3_refactor: refactor: migrate remaining duplicate config/loading paths

design_decision.rationale: Atlas has many existing pipeline references; legacy modules remain temporarily as thin compatibility layers
shim_policy: must contain NO duplicated business logic
must contain NO independent scheduler/config/retry implementation
canonical modules are the only home of real logic

bugs_fixed.title: Infinite recursion in classification shims
bugs_fixed.detail: batch_classify_v2._classify_one imported classify_source_shards/classify_source_shards_adaptive from the batch_classify shim, which forwarded back to _classify_one -> RecursionError on every adaptive run.
bugs_fixed.fix: batch_classify_v2.py is now the canonical home: real classify_source_shards, classify_source_shards_adaptive, merge_and_report, split_single_shard, _process_shard_worker, _process_task_worker, SummaryAccumulator and report helpers ported in; _classify_one calls module-local functions only; shim is a pure re-export. Verified no recursion (16/16 tests, smoke test runs end-to-end).

bugs_fixed.title: SourceConfig identity mismatch (stub poisoning)
bugs_fixed.detail: shim's try/except ImportError fallback created batch_classify.SourceConfig = type('SourceConfig', (), {}) — empty stub; shim.SourceConfig is not v2.SourceConfig; instantiation raised TypeError.
bugs_fixed.fix: batch_classify.py now imports SourceConfig (and ALL_SOURCES, functions) directly from batch_classify_v2 at module top — identity preserved in both import orders. Verified shim.SourceConfig is v2.SourceConfig.

bugs_fixed.title: Missing ALL_SOURCES export
bugs_fixed.detail: shim re-exported ALL_SOURCES as SourceConfig alias which fell into the stub fallback; no real ALL_SOURCES list.
bugs_fixed.fix: shim re-exports ALL_SOURCES directly from batch_classify_v2 (45 sources). Verified count = 45 in shim-first import order.

steps_executed.detail: Updated docs/architecture/scheduler_cleanup_design_v1.md: shim policy (may re-export, must contain no business logic), migration strategy, removal criteria for v2.0, rollback plan, risks, acceptance criteria, sign-off.

batch_classify_v2.py ported to canonical home (real implementations, parallel.* usage); batch_classify.py -> pure re-export shim; adaptive_scheduler.py -> forwarding shim (Task/TaskRegistry/plan_tasks/load_scheduler_config/write_scheduler_report forward to parallel.*, legacy field names preserved). Added parallel/monitor.write_legacy_scheduler_report for the legacy report shape.

run_classify_all_v2.py: replaced hand-rolled YAML loader + fallback parser with parallel.config.load_parallelism_config (sys.path bootstrap added). generate_knowledge_pack loader: evaluated — full Scheduler migration NOT safe (registry resume would skip re-read of changed curated files); converted inline closure to module-level _load_curated_file (picklable under spawn); documented rationale inline and in design doc 4.4.
test_adaptive_scheduler.py 16/16 (was 4/16); scheduler suites 104 passed; full suite 374 passed + pre-existing zstandard/unrelated failures.
Architecture validator RESULT: PASS (0 violations). Shim business-logic scan clean. No remaining duplicate parallelism.yaml readers outside parallel.config.

deferred_items.detail: hand-rolled YAML loader + fallback parser removed; uses parallel.config
full scheduler migration unsafe (registry resume would skip changed curated files); worker count from unified config; worker is module-level picklable; rationale documented
out of scope for Phase 5D per plan
classification uses stage1/stage2_shard_workers keys which the unified resolver ignores (returns 'auto'); batch_classify_v2 falls back to --workers default 8. Pre-existing behavior preserved.
